Any open, idle session can move engines — between two"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-loop-engine"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Pick **dsh web**'s agent loop engine **per session** — the built-in `in-process` loop (the default),"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" or one of the hosted engines `claude-code` / `codex` / `pi` / `kimi`. Sessions are independent: one"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" chat can run Codex while another runs Kimi. Any open, idle session can move engines — between two h"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"osted engines the handover is **in place**, and a move involving `in-process` **reloads the page** ("},{"id":"p3s5","text":"the `dsh web` process never restarts). Nothing in the main repository changes."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Boot `dsh web` once (the router retries for a bounded window while the base bundle still holds the a"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"gent-factory slot), then open **Settings → Loop engine**."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**Install notes**"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- The install rewrites one **engine-agnostic** managed block in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`; ev"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ery other byte you wrote there is preserved. Upgrading from an older release needs no hand edit.
- *"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"*Installing into any profile but `web`** — the Desktop app's `desktop`, a `headless` deployment, a r"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"enamed profile — needs `profile: <name>` in the composition entry for that profile:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"`profile` defaults to `web`, so without it the plugin writes its managed block into `<home>/profiles"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"/web/cordis.patch.yml` while the running profile never reads it: the plugin mounts, but the base `ag"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ent-loop` row is never disabled, so its router cannot take the factory slot and no hosted engine is "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"reachable. (Found by installing into the Desktop app.)
- **Uninstall** is `dsh plugin --profile web "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"remove dsh-loop-engine` **plus deleting that managed block** — the block outlives the plugin, and wh"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"ile it is present the profile has no agent factory, so no session can be created.
- **pnpm 10+** may"},{"id":"p10s7","text":" block dependency build scripts (`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`, naming `esbuild`, `@google/genai`, `prot"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"obufjs`). Run `pnpm approve-builds` (or add an `allowBuilds` entry) and retry; only the installing p"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"roject can grant this.
- **Booting the harness from its source checkout** additionally needs the pro"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"file's harness peers bridged with `file:` shims — otherwise session resume fails with `agent-presets"},{"id":"p10s11","text":": refusing to compose an unscoped context`. Steps in docs/source-checkout.md."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Engine | Needs, on the host |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Claude Code | the Claude Code CLI installed and logged in |
| Codex | `codex login`, or a `CODEX_A"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"PI_KEY` environment entry |
| Pi | whatever `pi` expects (its own `~/.pi/agent/auth.json`, or the pr"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ovider's API-key variable) |
| Kimi Code | the `kimi` CLI installed and logged in, on `PATH` (or pin"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ned via `kimiBin`) |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Version compatibility"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"One release serves the **0.1.5 line** (`>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.1.6-0`), the **0.1.7 line** (`>=0.1.7-rc.1 <"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"0.1.8-0`), the **0.2.0 line** (`>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.2.1-0`) and the **0.2.1 line** (`>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.2.2"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"-0`): the plugin detects the running generation at load and takes the matching code path. Those unio"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"n ranges are what it declares in `peerDependencies`, and a harness outside them fails loudly at boot"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"t declares in `peerDependencies`, and a harness outside them fails loudly at boot or session resume."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Read the version as `<harness line>-rcN`, where **`rcN` is this plugin's own release counter for tha"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"t line** — not the harness's `rc` number. Within a covered line a new harness `rc` needs no plugin r"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"elease unless an API surface moved; docs/compatibility.md §1 lists those surfaces and the diff comma"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"I surface moved; docs/compatibility.md §1 lists those surfaces and the diff command that decides it."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Plugin | Harness |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| `0.2.1-rc1` | `0.2.1-rc.1`, `0.2.1-rc.2` (and every earlier line it still covers) |
| `0.2.0-rc1` "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"| `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.2.0-rc.2` |
| `0.1.7-rc1` … `0.1.7-rc5` | `0.1.7-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.2` |
| `0.1.5-r"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"c3` … `0.1.5-rc5` | `0.1.5-rc.2` |
| `0.1.5-rc1` / `0.1.5-rc2` | `0.1.5-rc.1` |
| `1.0.0-rc8` … `1.0"},{"id":"p20s4","text":".0-rc15` | `0.1.2-rc.1` |
| `1.0.0-rc7` and earlier | `0.1.1-rc.2` |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"`0.2.1-rc1` is the first release that serves four lines at once. Two harness changes force it: the 0"},{"id":"p21s2","text":".2.1 line **deleted `@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants` and every `<package>/invariant` subpath**, and it "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"republished the JSONL durability backend as a namespace plugin with no default export. The plugin's "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"`./invariant` companion now declares the host registry's shape locally, so one build mounts on every"},{"id":"p21s5","text":" line — and, because dsh skips a whole bundle whose `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers do not satisfy the ru"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"nning version, dropping that package from `peerDependencies` is what lets the plugin load on 0.2.1 a"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"version, dropping that package from `peerDependencies` is what lets the plugin load on 0.2.1 at all."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **It replaces the harness's agent factory.** One facade serves every session, so the plugin promis"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"es to stay out of the way: any session it cannot answer for — including sessions with nothing to do "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"with hosted engines — degrades to the `in-process` loop instead of failing to open. See docs/per-ses"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"sion-engine.md §6.
- **The engine record is a sidecar**, `$DSH_HOME/.loop-engine/engines.json`, not "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"part of the session log: changing machine or `DSH_HOME` loses it and the session falls back to its p"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"reset. See §5.5.
- **Moving a session involving `in-process` reloads the page** — the harness loop n"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"either hands over a live session nor adopts one it did not create. See §5.2/§5.4.
- **Sessions that "},{"id":"p23s8","text":"already ran a turn** can still move, but only while idle, and the move rebuilds that session's agent"},{"id":"p23s9","text":". See §5.
- **Old sessions with the legacy preset id `loop-engine`** read as "legacy hosted engine" "},{"id":"p23s10","text":"until rebuilt once. See §7.
- **Same-engine sessions share that CLI's own auth directory**, with no "},{"id":"p23s11","text":"lock added by the plugin. See §6.
- **Switching back to `in-process` leaves the shared `external` gr"},{"id":"p23s12","text":"oup in the model menu** (the catalog is not scoped per session)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Where the details live"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- docs/per-session-engine.md — the full user-visible behavior (§ numbers above refer to it).
